episodes.title: The Great AI Infrastructure Land Grab
episodes.central_fight: Is the consolidation of AI infrastructure—from Nvidia’s $13B Hugging Face acquisition to Google’s exclusive cyber-defense tools—a necessary stabilization of the industry or a dangerous enclosure of the digital commons?
